flow.definition: Original mean of available native five-minute volume values in each quarter hour.

speed.label: Speed
speed.definition: Original quarter-hour mean speed and recorded source fill; physical units are not inferred from the Parquets.

congestion.label: Congestion index
congestion.definition: The source map slowdown relative to full-history nonzero speed P90, weighted by clipped log1p volume relative to frame volume P95.

provenance.clock: Source wall clock; timezone is unspecified.
provenance.selection: The supplied 720-road register and 2024-10-18 source date.
provenance.source_summary_definition: Original fifteen-minute pandas means and fills, followed by NumPy regional means before road-frame rounding.

csv.timestamp: POSIXct times are Unix seconds; numeric times retain the declared source clock.
csv.data: input.rds preserves original types, geometry, timezones and nested provenance.
